messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync — NimbusHW asked us to let them onboard "apac-southwest-2" as an edge region in the marketplace next sprint. They need quota entitlements and a marketplace SKU live by EOW. Who owns approvals?
ton y (nimbus-hw): We can supply 8 x A10 nodes at that PoP in week 2. Expect ~60k tokens/s sustained for their target shards. Need marketplace SKU + pricing band to be created.
samir (cloud-partners): Marketplace side: we need the marketplace entitlement file, billing SKU, and a partner contact for the onboarding form. Also quota request to cloud infra (we can pre-approve up to 16 nodes, but need internal sign-off for >16).
vikas (infra): From infra POV, autoscale group + healthchecks are straightforward. Two asks: (1) where should KV cache be placed (local PoP vs central)? (2) a fallback region policy if PoP is full. Also need estimated RPS and p95 latency target for capacity planning.
maya (partnerships): @tony can you send RPS/latency numbers? We should aim for p95 < 60ms for local inference to meet Nimbus SLA.
tony (nimbus-hw): Baseline: 3k rps, 55ms p95 with quantized 8-bit model. Spike calc: 7k rps sustained during marketing windows. We'll provide formal perf matrix later today.
leah (legal): Heads-up: marketplace listing requires our updated partner addendum + MSA signature for Nimbus. Are we relying on existing partner MSA or a new SOW? If new SOW, procurement lead time is ~2 weeks.
maya (partnerships): We should attempt to reuse existing MSA (signed 2024) — Tony, confirm they accept same terms. If not, escalate to @leah.
tony (nimbus-hw): They accept current MSA but request a short SOW for region-specific pricing. We'll draft SOW tonight.
samir (cloud-partners): For quota: I'll submit a soft request for 12 nodes to the cloud quota team. Need a short justification string — Maya, can you paste the product rationale?
maya (partnerships): Rationale: "NimbusHW wants APAC SouthWest PoP to reduce inference latency for APAC customers and participate in marketplace promotion. Expected initial committed demand = 3k rps; burst = 7k rps. Price band TBD with partner." Use that.
vikas (infra): Also: please add expected average sequence length and KV cache hitrate estimate — affects memory per node.
tony (nimbus-hw): Avg seq len 128 tokens, KV hitrate ~18% initially.
leah (legal): I'll prep a short addendum template for region SOWs. ETA tomorrow EOD.
samir (cloud-partners): Submitted quota ticket: ID #Q-2029-APACSW2. They asked for contact emails for escalation. Who should I list?
maya (partnerships): List: maya@redwood.com, samir@redwood.com, tony@nimbushw.com.
deploy-bot: Marketplace deploy checklist created: checklist/1858123456-apacsw2. Items: SKU mapping, entitlement file, legal addendum, quota approval, billing test.
vikas (infra): One more ops item: add canary policy — route 10% traffic to new PoP for first 48h. Can we auto-fallback to apac-north-1?
maya (partnerships): Yes. Canary + auto-fallback to apac-north-1. I'll note that in the rollout plan.
tony (nimbus-hw): We'll sign SOW and send perf matrix by 1800 PT. Can we target marketplace SKU publish on Friday?
samir (cloud-partners): If legal addendum is ready and quota approved, yes. Otherwise push to next Monday.
leah (legal): I can fast-track addendum if partnerships tags it priority. Please ping me if procurement is blocked.
maya (partnerships): Action list: (1) Tony: SOW + perf matrix (today). (2) Samir: quota ticket tracking (#Q-2029-APACSW2). (3) Vikas: prepare canary + fallback config. (4) Leah: addendum draft. (5) Maya: assemble marketplace SKU payload and publish checklist.
maya (partnerships): tagging owners in #boardroom for exec visibility: @ceo FYI (we're not announcing yet) :eyes:
tony (nimbus-hw): Thanks all — we'll follow up in this thread after SOW.
samir (cloud-partners): Noted. I'll update ticket with ETA once quota team responds.
vikas (infra): I'll open infra PR for canary config this afternoon.
leah (legal): Draft will be in Google Drive: /legal/partner-addendums/nimbus-apac-sw2.
maya (partnerships): Great progress. If anyone hits blockers, DM me. :thumbsup:
